raw_hints: Create a 10x10 rectangular pit approximately 6 blocks deep
Build outer walls with stonebrick in stepped layers (3-4 layers visible)
Add wooden log/plank interior framing horizontally across middle section
Top the structure with stone slabs forming a flat roof
Place a centered 4x4 glass window on the roof surface
Surround exterior with gravel/dirt at ground level
Ensure symmetrical appearance from all cardinal directions
rebuild_intent.summary: A partially underground bunker or storage structure with a flat roof. The building features a rectangular footprint with stepped concrete/stone exterior walls, wooden interior framing, and a single centered glass window on the roof. The structure is sunken into terrain with dirt/gravel surrounding it.
